Web Manga 'Real mo Tama ni wa Uso wo Tsuku' Gets TV Anime in 2027
Manga author Niichi announced on their official X account on Sunday that their Real mo Tama ni wa Uso wo Tsuku (Sometimes Even Reality Is a Lie!) web manga is receiving a television anime adaptation. Niichi drew an illustration to commemorate the announcement (pictured). The anime series will premiere in 2027. Niichi originally began posting the romantic comedy manga on their X (formerly Twitter) and Pixiv accounts in August 2018 under the title Game-zuki no Tomodachi to Iroiro suru Hanashi befo...
